idea-plugin.name: Gutachten-Lint: ImmoWertV 2021 und BewG
idea-plugin.description:
Findet veraltete Normen und Modellwerte in Verkehrswertgutachten — 13 Regeln

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Gutachten-Lint: ImmoWertV 2021 und BewG: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 13 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/immowertv-gutachten-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com

action.text: Gutachten-Lint: ImmoWertV 2021 und BewG: Check This File
